about.title: About Credit Card Interest Calculator - APR and Interest Cost Tool
about.description: The Credit Card Interest Calculator is a comprehensive credit card debt analysis tool designed to help you understand how much interest you'll pay on credit card balances and how different payment strategies affect total costs. This calculator shows daily, monthly, and annual interest charges, helping you make informed decisions about credit card payments and debt management. Whether you're planning payments or comparing credit card offers, this tool provides accurate interest calculations.

faq.q: How is credit card interest calculated?
faq.a: Credit card interest is calculated daily by dividing your APR by 365, then multiplying by your daily balance. This daily interest is added to your balance, creating compound interest that grows over time.

faq.q: Why is my actual interest different from the calculator?
faq.a: Actual interest may vary due to promotional rates, different APRs for purchases vs. cash advances, payment timing, and how your card company calculates average daily balance. This calculator provides estimates based on standard methods.

faq.q: How much can I save by paying more than the minimum?
faq.a: Paying extra can save substantial interest. For example, on a $5,000 balance at 18% APR, paying $200/month instead of the $100 minimum saves over $2,000 in interest and pays off the debt 3+ years sooner.

faq.q: When is credit card interest charged?
faq.a: Interest is typically charged on balances carried from month to month. If you pay your full statement balance by the due date, you usually avoid interest charges during the grace period (typically 21-25 days).
